# Glaze（釉） — Complete AI Agent Reference (llms-full.txt)

# Glaze UI — Getting Started & Registry Setup

Glaze is an accessible React 19 design system built on **Base UI 1.9** (`@base-ui/react`), **Tailwind CSS v4**, **Recharts v3**, **Phosphor Icons** (`@phosphor-icons/react`), and **shadcn/ui Registry**.

## 1. Configure `components.json`

Add the `@glaze` registry namespace to your project's `components.json`:

```json
{
  "$schema": "https://ui.shadcn.com/schema.json",
  "style": "glaze",
  "rsc": false,
  "tsx": true,
  "tailwind": {
    "css": "src/styles/glaze.css",
    "baseColor": "slate",
    "cssVariables": true
  },
  "iconLibrary": "phosphor",
  "aliases": {
    "components": "@/components",
    "utils": "@/lib",
    "ui": "@/components/ui",
    "lib": "@/lib",
    "hooks": "@/hooks"
  },
  "registries": {
    "@glaze": "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pengtikui/glaze-ui/main/public/r/{name}.json"
  }
}
```

## 2. Install Base Style & Tokens

```bash
npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/style
```

Import the generated stylesheet in your app entry (e.g., `src/main.tsx`):

```tsx
import './styles/glaze.css'
```

Wrap your app root with `TooltipProvider` and `ToastProvider` (plus optional `IconContext.Provider` from `@phosphor-icons/react`):

```tsx
import { IconContext } from '@phosphor-icons/react'
import { TooltipProvider } from '@/components/ui/tooltip'
import { ToastProvider } from '@/components/ui/toast'

export function Providers({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <IconContext.Provider value={{ weight: 'regular' }}>
      <TooltipProvider delay={160}>
        <ToastProvider>{children}</ToastProvider>
      </TooltipProvider>
    </IconContext.Provider>
  )
}
```

## 3. Install Components, Blocks, or Full Demos

```bash
# Install UI primitives
npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/button @glaze/dialog @glaze/select @glaze/bar-chart

# Install ready-made business cards (112 available)
npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/status-card @glaze/area-trend-card @glaze/data-table-card

# Install a complete demo page (6 available)
npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/demo-homelab
```

---

# Glaze Design Foundations & Strict Rules for AI Agents

## Canvas & Card Rules (CRITICAL)
- Page canvas background MUST be `#F2F4F8` (`--glaze-canvas`).
- Cards (`<Tile>`) have **NO border and NO box-shadow** on the canvas; elevation is created purely by surface contrast (white `#FFFFFF` or pastel tone against `#F2F4F8`).
- Border radius scale:
  - `rounded-tile` (`28px`): `Tile`, `Dialog`, `Drawer`
  - `rounded-overlay` (`20px`): floating popups (`Menu`, `Select`, `Popover`, `Combobox`, `ContextMenu`, `Toast`)
  - `rounded-inner` (`18px`): multiline & nested surfaces (`Textarea`, `Fieldset`, `Accordion`, `Collapsible`)
  - `rounded-full`: ALL single-line controls (`Button`, `Input`, `Select`, `Combobox`, `Autocomplete`, `NumberField`, `Switch`, `Toggle`, `Tabs`, `SegmentedControl`, `Menubar`, `Toolbar`) at standard `44px` height (`h-11`), soft background `#F6F7F9`, borderless by default.

## Color Tokens
- **9 Pastel Hue Families** (`Hue`): `sky`, `mint`, `peach`, `lilac`, `rose`, `lemon`, `aqua`, `periwinkle`, `coral` — each with 6 shades: `50, 100, 300, 500, 700, 900`.
- **14 Tile Tones** (`TileTone`): `white` + 9 pastel hues + 4 dark focus tones (`sky-dark`, `lilac-dark`, `aqua-dark`, `ink`).
- **5 Semantic Statuses** (`Status`): `normal` (mint), `warning` (peach), `error` (coral), `info` (sky), `disabled` (neutral).

## Base UI v1.9 Conventions (DO NOT USE RADIX PATTERNS)
- **NEVER** pass `asChild` (that is Radix UI). Base UI uses the `render` prop (e.g., `<BaseDialog.Trigger render={<Button>Open</Button>} />`) or Glaze's explicit `trigger={<Button>Open</Button>}` prop.
- Import directly from single component files: `@/components/ui/button`, `@/components/ui/tile`, `@/lib/tokens`, `@/lib/motion`.
- Utility class merger is `import { cn } from 'cn'` (`shadcn-ui/cn`).
- Icons come from `@phosphor-icons/react`.

## 4-Column Dense Bento Grid
- Use `<Grid>` (`.glaze-grid`: 4 cols desktop, 2 cols tablet, 1 col mobile, 16px gap, `grid-auto-flow: row dense`).
- Tile sizes:
  - `s` (1×1, min 200px)
  - `w` (2×1, min 200px)
  - `t` (1×2, min 416px)
  - `l` (2×2, min 416px)
  - `f` (full-width 4×auto)

## Motion Rules (CSS-First, GPU-Composited)
- NEVER use `backdrop-blur` on modal/drawer backdrops.
- `PRESS_SCALE` (`0.97`) is ONLY for standalone compact actions (`Button`, `Toggle`, `Checkbox`, `Radio`, `ToolbarButton`). NEVER scale popup triggers, `Select`, `Tabs`, `Switch`, or `Tile`.
- Duration tiers: Fast `150ms/120ms` (popups & press), Base `200ms/150ms` (tabs, switch, dialog, accordion), Emphasized `300ms/220ms` (drawer) & `360ms` (3D stacked toast).

# Glaze 6 Full-Page Business Demos

Each demo can be viewed standalone at `/view/demos/<slug>` (outside the docs frame) or installed via shadcn CLI.

| # | Title | Standalone Route | Registry CLI | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 01 | 家庭内网总控中心 (`HomelabDemoPage`) | `/view/demos/homelab` | `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/demo-homelab` | 管理物理主机、群晖 NAS、Docker 容器、应用发射台、硬件温度与家庭网络拓扑的内网总控仪表盘。 |
| 02 | 研发协作工作台 (`WorkspaceDemoPage`) | `/view/demos/workspace` | `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/demo-workspace` | 覆盖迭代里程碑、CI/CD 部署状态、双列迷你看板、甘特排期、团队贡献榜与代码热力图的研发协作中心。 |
| 03 | 全屋智能家居中控 (`SmartHomeDemoPage`) | `/view/demos/smart-home` | `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/demo-smart-home` | 面向大屏平板与桌面的智能家居控制中心，集成房间传感器矩阵、空调温控、灯光滑块与全屋场景一键联动。 |
| 04 | SaaS 营收与财务驾驶舱 (`AnalyticsDemoPage`) | `/view/demos/analytics` | `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/demo-analytics` | 融合 Recharts v3 交互式多视图趋势、全年双轴组合分析、转化漏斗、收入构成与多维指标对比的经营分析大屏。 |
| 05 | 个人效率与数字生活 OS (`PersonalOsDemoPage`) | `/view/demos/personal-os` | `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/demo-personal-os` | 整合番茄钟、交互待办清单、习惯打卡矩阵、日历议程、心率饮水与灵感速记的个人数字生活仪表盘。 |
| 06 | 云原生运维与可观测性中心 (`CloudOpsDemoPage`) | `/view/demos/cloud-ops` | `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/demo-cloud-ops` | 展示全站 30 日 SLA 状态、集群资源三环监控、告警事件日志、散点延迟分布与全局命令栏的 SRE 运维中心。 |
| 07 | 企业级控制台壳层 (`AdminShellDemoPage`) | `/view/demos/admin-shell` | `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/demo-admin-shell` | 带完整侧边栏与顶部栏的 App Shell 仪表盘示例，大屏侧边栏贴靠最左侧，支持全宽/居中画布与悬浮/贴边侧栏切换，涵盖 15 种常见菜单类型（工作区切换、搜索过滤、2/3 级树形折叠、状态点、动态计数、右键/悬停菜单、内嵌开关、锁定态与迷你图标栏）。 |
| 08 | AI 智能体工作台 (`AiStudioDemoPage`) | `/view/demos/ai-studio` | `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/demo-ai-studio` | 集成 12 个 Glaze AI Elements 与 10 张 AI Bento 业务卡片的全景工作台，支持「智能体分栏对话与产物审查」与「AI Ops 四列看板」双模式无缝切换。 |
| 09 | 网络与架构拓扑观测台 (`NetworkTopologyDemoPage`) | `/view/demos/network-topology` | `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/demo-network-topology` | 基于 @xyflow/react 与 elkjs 构建的通用拓扑监控观测工作台，内置「云原生多可用区微服务架构」与「物理 / VLAN 万兆网络」双场景切换、实时流量动效、上下游路径追踪与故障级联演练。 |
| 10 | 家庭内网与 Homelab 架构图 (`HomeNetworkDemoPage`) | `/view/demos/home-network` | `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/demo-home-network` | 面向极客家庭与 Homelab 的全屋网络拓扑观测台，支持「全屋物理布线与四区 VLAN」与「自托管服务与 Tailscale 远程回家」双视角切换，基于 elkjs 自动防重叠排布。 |

# UI Components API Reference (58 Components)

## Grid (四列密集栅格) — `@glaze/grid`

Glaze 4 列 dense 自动排布栅格容器，桌面 4 列 / 平板 2 列 / 手机 1 列，支持预览列数覆盖。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/grid`
- Import: `import { Grid } from '@/components/ui/grid'`
- Registry Deps: @glaze/style

**Grid Props:**
- `forceCols: 4 | 2 | 1` — Force preview column count (used by responsive grid demos)

## Tile (釉面卡片容器) — `@glaze/tile`

无描边、无阴影的核心卡片容器，内置 9 组柔彩 + 4 组深色 + 纯白 14 种主题，通过 Context 向子图表与图标传递色彩。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/tile`
- Import: `import { useTileTheme, Tile } from '@/components/ui/tile'`
- Registry Deps: @glaze/style, @glaze/tokens

**Tile Props:**
- `tone: TileTone` = 'white'
- `size: TileSize` = 's'
- `interactive: boolean` = false
- `padding: 'default' | 'compact' | 'none'` = 'default'
- `href: string`

**Data Attributes:** `data-tone` (当前卡片色调（white | sky | mint | ... | ink）), `data-size` (当前卡片栅格尺寸（s | w | t | l | f）)

## StatusPill (语义状态胶囊) — `@glaze/status-pill`

用于展示正常 / 注意 / 异常 / 信息 / 停用 5 种语义状态的胶囊徽章，可选呼吸状态点。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/status-pill`
- Import: `import { StatusPill } from '@/components/ui/status-pill'`
- Registry Deps: @glaze/tokens

**StatusPill Props:**
- `status: Status` (required)
- `label: string`
- `showDot: boolean` = true
- `size: 'sm' | 'md'` = 'md'

## HueTag (柔彩色相标签) — `@glaze/hue-tag`

基于 9 组 Glaze 柔彩色板的轻量标签，支持 xs / sm / md 尺寸与浅/深变体。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/hue-tag`
- Import: `import { HueTag } from '@/components/ui/hue-tag'`
- Registry Deps: @glaze/tokens

**HueTag Props:**
- `hue: Hue` = 'periwinkle'
- `tone: 'soft' | 'solid' | 'neutral'` = 'soft'
- `size: 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md'` = 'md'

## StatusDot (语义状态点) — `@glaze/status-dot`

展示实时在线/告警状态的圆点指示器，支持 CSS 涟漪扩散（normal）与呼吸闪烁（warning/error）动画。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/status-dot`
- Import: `import { StatusDot } from '@/components/ui/status-dot'`
- Registry Deps: @glaze/style, @glaze/tokens

**StatusDot Props:**
- `status: Status` = 'normal'
- `color: string`
- `mode: 'static' | 'ripple' | 'blink'`
- `animated: boolean` = false
- `size: number | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg'` = 8

## CountBadge (数字角标) — `@glaze/count-badge`

紧凑的等宽数字计数徽章，支持 9 组色相自动配色。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/count-badge`
- Import: `import { CountBadge } from '@/components/ui/count-badge'`
- Registry Deps: @glaze/tokens

**CountBadge Props:**
- `count: number | string` (required)
- `hue: Hue | 'ink' | 'neutral'` = 'coral'

## IconTile (图标方砖) — `@glaze/icon-tile`

用于应用图标与列表前置标识的柔彩圆角方砖，可自动感知父级 Tile 深浅背景。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/icon-tile`
- Import: `import { IconTile } from '@/components/ui/icon-tile'`
- Registry Deps: @glaze/style, @glaze/tile, @glaze/tokens

**IconTile Props:**
- `hue: Hue | 'neutral' | 'dark' | 'dark-glass' | 'coral-solid'` = 'sky'
- `size: 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg' | 'xl'` = 'md'
- `radius: 'icon' | 'app' | 'full'` = 'app'
- `badge: number`
- `badgeRingColor: string` = '#FFFFFF'

## Textarea (多行文本域) — `@glaze/textarea`

采用 18px 圆角（rounded-inner）与柔灰底色（#F6F7F9）的多行输入框。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/textarea`
- Import: `import { Textarea } from '@/components/ui/textarea'`
- Registry Deps: @glaze/motion

**Textarea Props:**
- `surface: 'soft' | 'white'` = 'soft'

## SegmentedControl (分段控制器) — `@glaze/segmented-control`

基于 Base UI Tabs 封装的胶囊分段切换器，内置平滑纯 CSS 滑动指示块。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/segmented-control`
- Import: `import { SegmentedControl } from '@/components/ui/segmented-control'`
- Base UI: `@base-ui/react/tabs` (https://base-ui.com/react/components/tabs)

**SegmentedControl Props:**
- `options: SegmentedOption<T>[]` (required)
- `value: T` (required)
- `onValueChange: (val: T) => void` (required)
- `size: 'sm' | 'md'` = 'md'
- `dark: boolean` = false
- `ariaLabel: string`
- `listClassName: string`
- `className: string`

**Data Attributes:** `data-active` (当前选中的分段项), `data-disabled` (禁用状态的分段项)

## Button (按钮) — `@glaze/button`

全圆胶囊按钮，提供 7 种语义与表面变体，独立使用时启用 0.97 按压缩放，作为浮层触发器时自动禁用缩放以防锚点抖动。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/button`
- Import: `import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button'`
- Base UI: `@base-ui/react/button` (https://base-ui.com/react/components/button)
- Registry Deps: @glaze/motion, @glaze/tokens

**Button Props:**
- `variant: ButtonVariant` = 'primary'
- `size: ButtonSize` = 'md'
- `hue: Hue` = 'periwinkle'
- `pressScale: boolean` = true — Enable scale(0.97) tactile press feedback. Automatically disabled when used as a popup trigger.
- `className: string`
- `style: React.CSSProperties`

**Data Attributes:** `data-disabled` (按钮处于禁用态时添加), `data-popup-open` (当按钮作为浮层触发器且浮层打开时添加)

## Input (输入框) — `@glaze/input`

基于 Base UI Input 的 44px 全圆胶囊单行输入框，支持前后缀图标与柔灰/纯白两种表面。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/input`
- Import: `import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'`
- Base UI: `@base-ui/react/input` (https://base-ui.com/react/components/input)
- Registry Deps: @glaze/motion

**Input Props:**
- `leadingIcon: React.ReactNode`
- `trailingElement: React.ReactNode`
- `surface: 'soft' | 'white'` = 'soft'
- `inputSize: 'sm' | 'md'` = 'md'
- `className: string`
- `wrapperClassName: string`

**Data Attributes:** `data-disabled` (输入框禁用态), `data-focused` (获得焦点时添加), `data-invalid` (在 Field 校验失败时添加)

## NumberField (数字步进框) — `@glaze/number-field`

支持键盘微调、拖动增减（Scrub）、范围限制与单位后缀的无障碍数值输入控件。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/number-field`
- Import: `import { NumberField } from '@/components/ui/number-field'`
- Base UI: `@base-ui/react/number-field` (https://base-ui.com/react/components/number-field)
- Registry Deps: @glaze/motion, @glaze/style

**NumberField Props:**
- `label: string`
- `unit: string`
- `surface: 'soft' | 'white'` = 'soft'
- `className: string`

**Data Attributes:** `data-disabled` (禁用态), `data-scrubbing` (正在通过指针拖动调节数值)

## OTPField (验证码输入框) — `@glaze/otp-field`

基于 Base UI v1.9 OTPField 构建的一次性密码/验证码分段输入框，支持自动跳格与粘贴填充。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/otp-field`
- Import: `import { OTPField } from '@/components/ui/otp-field'`
- Base UI: `@base-ui/react/otp-field` (https://base-ui.com/react/components/otp-field)
- Registry Deps: @glaze/style

**OTPField Props:**
- `length: number` = 6
- `separatorAt: number` = 3
- `className: string`

**Data Attributes:** `data-filled` (该槽位已输入字符), `data-focused` (该槽位处于聚焦激活态)

## Checkbox (复选框) — `@glaze/checkbox`

支持选中、未选中与半选（indeterminate）状态，内置描述文案与按压反馈。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/checkbox`
- Import: `import { Checkbox } from '@/components/ui/checkbox'`
- Base UI: `@base-ui/react/checkbox` (https://base-ui.com/react/components/checkbox)

**Checkbox Props:**
- `label: React.ReactNode`
- `description: string`
- `className: string`

**Data Attributes:** `data-checked` (已选中状态), `data-unchecked` (未选中状态), `data-indeterminate` (半选状态), `data-disabled` (禁用状态)

## CheckboxGroup (复选框组) — `@glaze/checkbox-group`

管理多组 Checkbox 共享选中值数组，支持全选联动（parent checkbox）。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/checkbox-group`
- Import: `import { CheckboxGroup } from '@/components/ui/checkbox-group'`
- Base UI: `@base-ui/react/checkbox-group` (https://base-ui.com/react/components/checkbox-group)

**Data Attributes:** `data-disabled` (整组禁用状态)

## Radio (单选框) — `@glaze/radio`

配合 RadioGroup 使用的单项选择控件，带有清晰圆点指示与标签描述。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/radio`
- Import: `import { Radio } from '@/components/ui/radio'`
- Base UI: `@base-ui/react/radio` (https://base-ui.com/react/components/radio)
- Registry Deps: @glaze/style

**Radio Props:**
- `label: React.ReactNode`
- `description: string`
- `card: boolean` = false
- `className: string`

**Data Attributes:** `data-checked` (选中状态), `data-unchecked` (未选中状态), `data-disabled` (禁用状态)

## RadioGroup (单选框组) — `@glaze/radio-group`

支持方向键漫游焦点的无障碍单选组容器。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/radio-group`
- Import: `import { RadioGroup } from '@/components/ui/radio-group'`
- Base UI: `@base-ui/react/radio-group` (https://base-ui.com/react/components/radio-group)

**Data Attributes:** `data-disabled` (整组禁用状态)

## Switch (开关) — `@glaze/switch`

即时生效的胶囊开关控件，采用 200ms 纯 CSS 滑块过渡，支持 9 组色相自定义激活色。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/switch`
- Import: `import { Switch } from '@/components/ui/switch'`
- Base UI: `@base-ui/react/switch` (https://base-ui.com/react/components/switch)
- Registry Deps: @glaze/tokens

**Switch Props:**
- `hue: Hue | 'ink'` = 'mint'
- `size: 'sm' | 'md'` = 'md'
- `className: string`

**Data Attributes:** `data-checked` (开启状态), `data-unchecked` (关闭状态), `data-disabled` (禁用状态)

## Slider (滑块) — `@glaze/slider`

单值与双端区间范围滑块，支持色相主题、步进与键盘精确微调。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/slider`
- Import: `import { Slider } from '@/components/ui/slider'`
- Base UI: `@base-ui/react/slider` (https://base-ui.com/react/components/slider)
- Registry Deps: @glaze/style, @glaze/tokens

**Slider Props:**
- `hue: Hue | 'ink'` = 'periwinkle'
- `label: string`
- `showValue: boolean` = true
- `unit: string` = ''
- `className: string`

**Data Attributes:** `data-dragging` (正在拖拽滑块), `data-disabled` (禁用状态)

## Toggle (切换按钮) — `@glaze/toggle`

带有按下（pressed）状态的双态胶囊按钮，适用于工具栏格式化、收藏、置顶等操作。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/toggle`
- Import: `import { Toggle } from '@/components/ui/toggle'`
- Base UI: `@base-ui/react/toggle` (https://base-ui.com/react/components/toggle)
- Registry Deps: @glaze/motion

**Toggle Props:**
- `size: 'sm' | 'md'` = 'md'
- `pressScale: boolean` = true
- `className: string`

**Data Attributes:** `data-pressed` (按钮处于激活按下态), `data-disabled` (禁用状态)

## ToggleGroup (切换按钮组) — `@glaze/toggle-group`

协调一组 Toggle 的单选或多选状态，内置柔灰胶囊轨道容器。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/toggle-group`
- Import: `import { ToggleGroup } from '@/components/ui/toggle-group'`
- Base UI: `@base-ui/react/toggle-group` (https://base-ui.com/react/components/toggle-group)

**Data Attributes:** `data-multiple` (允许同时选中多项)

## Field (表单字段) — `@glaze/field`

自动关联 Label、Control、Description 与 Error 的无障碍表单字段容器。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/field`
- Import: `import { Field, FieldLabel, FieldDescription, FieldError, FieldControl } from '@/components/ui/field'`
- Base UI: `@base-ui/react/field` (https://base-ui.com/react/components/field)

**Data Attributes:** `data-invalid` (字段校验未通过), `data-valid` (字段校验通过), `data-dirty` (字段值已变更), `data-touched` (字段已失焦触碰)

## Fieldset (表单分组) — `@glaze/fieldset`

将相关表单字段归类到带标题（FieldsetLegend）的 18px 圆角区块内。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/fieldset`
- Import: `import { Fieldset, FieldsetLegend } from '@/components/ui/fieldset'`
- Base UI: `@base-ui/react/fieldset` (https://base-ui.com/react/components/fieldset)
- Registry Deps: @glaze/style

**Data Attributes:** `data-disabled` (整组禁用态)

## Form (表单容器) — `@glaze/form`

基于 TanStack Form (@tanstack/react-form) 封装的类型安全表单容器与字段原语，内置同步/异步校验、服务端错误映射、细粒度状态订阅，无缝搭配 Input、Select、Textarea、Checkbox 等 Glaze 基础控件。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/form`
- Import: `import { createFormHook, createFormHookContexts, formOptions, revalidateLogic, useField, useForm, useStore, formatFormError, getFieldErrors, isFieldInvalid, useFormContext, useFormField, Form, FormItem, FormLabel, FormControl, FormDescription, FormMessage, FormErrors, FormSubscribe, FormSubmit, FormReset } from '@/components/ui/form'`
- Registry Deps: @glaze/button

**Form Props:**
- `form: AnyFormApi` — TanStack Form instance created with `useForm()`
- `onSubmit: React.FormEventHandler<HTMLFormElement>` — Optional submit event handler invoked alongside `form.handleSubmit()`
- `noValidate: boolean` — Disable native browser validation popups (defaults to `true` when `form` is provided)

**FormItem Props:**
- `field: AnyFieldApi` — TanStack Form field API from `<form.Field>` or `useField()`
- `invalid: boolean` — Manually override invalid state
- `disabled: boolean` = false — Mark the field group as disabled
- `errorVisibility: FormErrorVisibility` = 'touched' — Control when validation errors become visible

**FormLabel Props:**
- `required: boolean` = false — Render a visual required indicator next to the label text

**FormControl Props:**
- `children: React.ReactElement<any>` (required) — Single Glaze input/control element (e.g. Input, Textarea, Select)

**FormMessage Props:**
- `field: AnyFieldApi` — Optional TanStack Form field override when rendered outside `<FormItem>`
- `errorVisibility: FormErrorVisibility` = 'touched' — Control when validation errors become visible (used when `field` prop is passed directly)
- `showAll: boolean` = false — Join all error messages instead of showing only the first
- `validatingText: React.ReactNode` — Optional hint shown while an async field validator is pending

**FormErrors Props:**
- `form: AnyFormApi` — Optional TanStack Form instance (defaults to nearest `<Form form={form}>`)

**FormSubscribe Props:**
- `form: AnyFormApi` — Optional TanStack Form instance (defaults to nearest `<Form form={form}>`)
- `selector: (state: AnyFormApi['state']) => TSelected` (required) — Selector deriving the subscribed slice from `form.state`
- `children: (state: TSelected) => React.ReactNode` (required) — Render callback receiving the selected form state slice

**FormSubmit Props:**
- `form: AnyFormApi` — Optional TanStack Form instance (defaults to nearest `<Form form={form}>`)
- `pendingText: React.ReactNode` — Label rendered while `form.state.isSubmitting` is true
- `disableWhenInvalid: boolean` = false — Also disable the submit button whenever `form.state.canSubmit` is false

**FormReset Props:**
- `form: AnyFormApi` — Optional TanStack Form instance (defaults to nearest `<Form form={form}>`)
- `disableWhenPristine: boolean` = false — Disable the reset button when the form has no unsaved changes (`!isDirty`)

**Data Attributes:** `data-invalid` (字段校验未通过（自动同步至 FormItem、FormLabel 与 FormControl 子控件）), `data-valid` (字段已触碰且校验通过), `data-dirty` (字段值相对默认值已发生变更), `data-touched` (字段已被触碰或失焦), `data-validating` (异步校验器正在执行), `data-submitting` (FormSubmit 处于异步提交进行中)

## Calendar (日历选择器) — `@glaze/calendar`

基于 react-day-picker v10 与 date-fns v4 封装的 Glaze 日历原语，内置中文（zh-CN）与周一首日、单选/多选/日期区间、多月并排、年月下拉快选、周数显示、9 组柔彩色相强调与自定义单元格扩展。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/calendar`
- Import: `import { CalendarDayButton, Calendar } from '@/components/ui/calendar'`
- Registry Deps: @glaze/motion, @glaze/style, @glaze/tokens

**CalendarDayButton Props:**
- `showTodayDot: boolean` = true — 是否在未选中的“今日”下方展示圆点指示

**Calendar Props:**
- `accent: CalendarAccent` = 'ink' — 选中态与区间高亮色：默认 ink（墨色主按钮 + 长春花柔和区间），或 9 组 Glaze 柔彩色相之一
- `surface: CalendarSurface` = 'card' — 外层表面形态：card（纯白 28px 釉面卡）、soft（柔灰内嵌块）、embedded（透明无内边距，适合 Popover / Tile 内嵌）
- `size: CalendarSize` = 'md' — 日期单元格尺寸密度：sm (32px) | md (36px) | lg (42px)
- `showTodayDot: boolean` = true — 是否在“今日”数字下方显示圆点提示（仅未选中今日时显示）

**Data Attributes:** `data-accent` (当前强调色主题（ink | sky | mint | peach | lilac | rose | lemon | aqua | periwinkle | coral）), `data-surface` (外层表面形态（card | soft | embedded）), `data-size` (日期格子尺寸密度（sm | md | lg）), `data-selected-single` (单选/多选模式下处于选中态的日期按钮), `data-range-start` (范围选择起始日期按钮), `data-range-middle` (范围选择中间连续区间日期按钮), `data-range-end` (范围选择结束日期按钮), `data-today` (今日高亮标记), `data-outside` (属于上月或下月的补齐日期), `data-disabled` (不可选择的禁用日期)

- `overflowBg: string` = '#F2F3F5'
- `overflowFg: string` = '#5B6170'
- `max: number`
- `className: string`

- `sticky: boolean` = false — Stick header cell to top when scrolling vertically

**TableCell Props:**
- `align: 'left' | 'center' | 'right'` = 'left' — Horizontal alignment of cell content

**Data Attributes:** `data-density` (表格密度（compact | comfortable | spacious）), `data-selected` (当前行处于选中高亮态)

## DataTable (数据表格) — `@glaze/data-table`

基于 Table 语义原语与 TanStack Table v9 封装的完备数据表格组件，内置排序、全局搜索、分段筛选、多选批量操作、行展开、列显隐、密度切换与分页。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/data-table`
- Import: `import { createGlazeColumnHelper, DataTable } from '@/components/ui/data-table'`
- Registry Deps: @glaze/button, @glaze/checkbox, @glaze/input, @glaze/motion, @glaze/popover, @glaze/segmented-control, @glaze/select, @glaze/style, @glaze/table, @glaze/tile, @glaze/tokens

**DataTable Props:**
- `data: TData[]` (required) — Data array (keep memoized or state-backed for stable row models)
- `columns: DataTableColumnDef<TData, any>[]` (required) — TanStack Table v9 column definitions
- `getRowId: (originalRow: TData, index: number) => string` — Optional stable row ID extractor
- `title: React.ReactNode` — Optional card title
- `description: React.ReactNode` — Optional card subtitle / description
- `tone: TileTone` = 'white' — Card tone when wrapped in Tile (defaults to 'white')
- `embedded: boolean` = false — Render bare without the outer Glaze Tile wrapper
- `density: TableDensity` — Controlled row density
- `defaultDensity: TableDensity` = 'comfortable' — Default row density when uncontrolled
- `onDensityChange: (density: TableDensity) => void` — Callback when density is changed via the toolbar button
- `enableDensityToggle: boolean` = false — Show interactive density toggle button in toolbar
- `searchable: boolean` = true — Enable global keyword search input
- `searchPlaceholder: string` = '搜索关键字…' — Placeholder text for global search input
- `facetFilter: DataTableFacetFilter` — Quick segmented filter bound to a specific column
- `enableSorting: boolean` = true — Enable sorting on sortable columns (default: true)
- `initialSorting: SortingState` = [] — Initial sorting state
- `enableRowSelection: boolean` = false — Enable multi-row selection with Glaze checkboxes
- `rowSelection: RowSelectionState` — Controlled row selection state
- `onRowSelectionChange: React.Dispatch<React.SetStateAction<RowSelectionState>>` — Controlled row selection updater
- `bulkActions: (selectedRows: TData[], clearSelection: () => void) => React.ReactNode` — Custom bulk action controls shown when 1+ rows are selected
- `renderSubComponent: (row: DataTableRow<TData>) => React.ReactNode` — Render an expandable detail panel below each row
- `getRowCanExpand: (row: DataTableRow<TData>) => boolean` — Optional predicate controlling whether a specific row can expand
- `enableColumnVisibility: boolean` = false — Enable column visibility selector popover
- `initialColumnVisibility: Record<string, boolean>` = {} — Initial column visibility map
- `enablePagination: boolean` = true — Enable client-side pagination footer (default: true)
- `defaultPageSize: number` = 5 — Initial page size (default: 5)
- `pageSizeOptions: number[]` = [5, 10, 20, 50] — Page size choices in footer select
- `stickyHeader: boolean` = false — Sticky header inside a vertically scrollable viewport
- `striped: boolean` = false — Show subtle alternating stripe background
- `loading: boolean` = false — Loading skeleton state
- `onRowClick: (row: TData) => void` — Row click handler (ignored when clicking interactive controls inside a row)
- `toolbarActions: React.ReactNode` — Extra action buttons placed on the right side of the toolbar
- `emptyTitle: string` = '暂无匹配数据' — Empty state heading
- `emptyDescription: string` = '尝试调整搜索关键字或筛选条件后再查看。' — Empty state description
- `emptyAction: React.ReactNode` — Custom empty state action
- `minTableWidth: number | string` = 680 — Minimum table width before horizontal scroll activates
- `className: string` — Extra container classes

**Data Attributes:** `data-density` (表格密度（compact | comfortable | spacious）), `data-selected` (当前行处于勾选选中态)

## Sidebar (应用侧边栏) — `@glaze/sidebar`

参考 shadcn/ui 架构并结合 Base UI 1.9 与 Glaze 视觉规范打造的可组合侧边栏系统，内置 floating / sidebar / inset 三种布局变体、图标栏收起浮层、多级树形折叠、⌘B 快捷键与移动端抽屉。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/sidebar`
- Import: `import { useSidebar, SidebarProvider, Sidebar, SidebarInset, SidebarTrigger, SidebarRail, SidebarHeader, SidebarFooter, SidebarContent, SidebarSeparator, SidebarGroup, SidebarGroupLabel, SidebarGroupAction, SidebarGroupContent, SidebarMenu, SidebarMenuItem, SidebarMenuButton, SidebarMenuAction, SidebarMenuBadge, SidebarMenuSub, SidebarMenuSubItem, SidebarMenuSubButton, SidebarMenuCollapsible, SidebarMenuSkeleton } from '@/components/ui/sidebar'`
- Registry Deps: @glaze/button, @glaze/motion, @glaze/popover, @glaze/style, @glaze/tooltip

**SidebarProvider Props:**
- `defaultOpen: boolean` = true — Initial expanded state when uncontrolled (default: true)
- `open: boolean` — Controlled expanded state
- `onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void` — Controlled expanded state change callback
- `openMobile: boolean` — Controlled mobile drawer open state
- `onOpenMobileChange: (open: boolean) => void` — Controlled mobile drawer state change callback
- `variant: SidebarVariant` = 'floating' — Layout variant shared with Sidebar & SidebarInset (default: 'floating')
- `shortcut: string | false` = 'b' — Keyboard shortcut letter paired with ⌘/Ctrl (default: 'b'; pass false to disable)
- `sidebarWidth: string` = '280px' — Expanded sidebar width CSS length (default: '280px')
- `sidebarWidthIcon: string` = '76px' — Collapsed icon-rail width CSS length (default: '76px')
- `sidebarWidthMobile: string` = '300px' — Mobile drawer width CSS length (default: '300px')
- `contained: boolean` = false — Render inside a bounded container (e.g. docs preview) instead of full viewport

**Sidebar Props:**
- `side: SidebarSide` = 'left' — Which side the sidebar docks to (default: 'left')
- `variant: SidebarVariant` — Visual surface style (inherits from SidebarProvider if omitted)
- `collapsible: SidebarCollapsible` = 'icon' — Collapse behavior on desktop (default: 'icon')
- `mobileTitle: React.ReactNode` = '导航菜单' — Header title displayed inside the mobile navigation Drawer

**SidebarTrigger Props:**
- `icon: React.ReactNode` — Custom icon override
- `collapseLabel: string` = '收起侧边栏 (⌘B)' — Tooltip text when expanded
- `expandLabel: string` = '展开侧边栏 (⌘B)' — Tooltip text when collapsed

**SidebarGroupLabel Props:**
- `collapsible: boolean` = false — Allow clicking the section label to collapse/expand the group
- `open: boolean` = true — Current open state when collapsible=true
- `onToggle: () => void` — Toggle handler when collapsible=true
- `action: React.ReactNode` — Optional inline action slot (e.g. SidebarGroupAction '+' button)

**SidebarGroupAction Props:**
- `tooltip: string`

**SidebarMenuButton Props:**
- `isActive: boolean` = false — Highlights the item in Glaze soft periwinkle pill state
- `size: 'sm' | 'default' | 'lg'` = 'default' — Height size preset
- `icon: React.ReactNode` — Leading icon element
- `trailing: React.ReactNode` — Trailing badge, shortcut, or status pill (auto-hidden in collapsed icon-rail)
- `tooltip: React.ReactNode` — Tooltip shown in collapsed icon-rail mode or always when provided
- `disabled: boolean` = false — Disable interaction & show muted locked styling
- `href: string` — Render as external or internal <a> link when provided
- `target: string` — Link target when href is set
- `rel: string` — Link rel when href is set
- `forceExpanded: boolean` = false — Force expanded rendering (e.g. inside a collapsed rail flyout Popover)
- `onClick: React.MouseEventHandler<HTMLElement>` — Click handler
- `aria-label: string` — Accessible label
- `className: string`
- `children: React.ReactNode`

**SidebarMenuAction Props:**
- `showOnHover: boolean` = false — Only reveal on parent SidebarMenuItem hover (or when popup is open)

**SidebarMenuSubButton Props:**
- `isActive: boolean` = false
- `size: 'sm' | 'md'` = 'md'
- `icon: React.ReactNode`
- `trailing: React.ReactNode`
- `href: string`
- `onClick: React.MouseEventHandler<HTMLElement>`
- `className: string`
- `children: React.ReactNode`

**SidebarMenuCollapsible Props:**
- `icon: React.ReactNode` (required) — Leading icon
- `label: string` (required) — Group trigger label
- `badge: React.ReactNode` — Optional badge shown before the caret (e.g. '3级')
- `open: boolean` — Controlled open state
- `defaultOpen: boolean` = false — Initial open state when uncontrolled
- `onOpenChange: (open: boolean) => void` — Open state change handler
- `hasActiveChild: boolean` = false — Highlight trigger text & icon when a child route is active
- `level: 0 | 1` = 0 — Nesting depth (0 = top-level group, 1 = 2nd-level nested group for 3-level trees)
- `flyoutContent: React.ReactNode` — Popover flyout content displayed when sidebar is collapsed to icon-rail mode
- `children: React.ReactNode` (required) — Child menu items rendered inside SidebarMenuSub

**SidebarMenuSkeleton Props:**
- `showIcon: boolean` = true
- `className: string`

**Data Attributes:** `data-state` (桌面展开或收起态（expanded | collapsed）), `data-collapsible` (收起模式（icon | offcanvas | ""）), `data-variant` (外观变体（floating | sidebar | inset）), `data-side` (停靠方向（left | right）), `data-active` (当前菜单项处于激活路由态)

## Resizable (可调分栏面板) — `@glaze/resizable`

基于 react-resizable-panels v4 封装的可拖拽分栏布局原语，支持水平/垂直嵌套、line/pill/gap 三种分隔把手形态、面板折叠展开、吸附刻度、延迟预览线、命令式控制与布局持久化。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/resizable`
- Import: `import { ResizablePanelGroup, ResizablePanel, ResizableHandle, ResizableSeparatorOverlay, useDefaultLayout, useGroupRef, usePanelRef, useParentGroup, useParentPanel } from '@/components/ui/resizable'`
- Registry Deps: @glaze/tokens

**ResizablePanelGroup Props:**
- `orientation: ResizableOrientation` = 'horizontal' — 面板排列方向：horizontal（左右分栏）或 vertical（上下分栏）
- `className: string` — 自定义外层容器类名

**ResizablePanel Props:**
- `className: string` — 面板内容区类名（react-resizable-panels v4 会将其应用到内部 Flex 子节点）

**ResizableHandle Props:**
- `withHandle: boolean` = false — 是否在分隔条中央显示带抓手图标的胶囊把手
- `variant: ResizableHandleVariant` = 'line' — 分隔条视觉形态：line（细线）、pill（柔和胶囊轨道）、gap（透明画布槽，适合分割 Glaze Tile 卡片）
- `hue: Hue` = 'periwinkle' — 悬停、聚焦与拖拽激活时的 Glaze 色相强调色
- `className: string` — 自定义分隔条容器类名

**ResizableSeparatorOverlay Props:**
- `hue: Hue` = 'periwinkle' — 延迟预览线的 Glaze 色相强调色
- `className: string` — 自定义预览线类名

**Data Attributes:** `data-orientation` (面板分组排列方向（horizontal | vertical）), `data-variant` (分隔把手外观变体（line | pill | gap）), `data-separator` (分隔把手交互状态（inactive | hover | focus | active | disabled）), `data-separator-overlay` (延迟预览线激活状态（active | inactive）)

- `nodes: TopologyFlowNode[]` (required) — Topology nodes (including optional `topologyGroup` parent containers)
- `edges: TopologyFlowEdge[]` (required) — Topology links connecting nodes
- `direction: TopologyDirection` — Active layout direction controlling port handle placement
- `animateFlow: boolean` — Toggle animated directional traffic flow on edges
- `density: 'compact' | 'detailed'` — Default visual density for device/service nodes
- `selection: TopologySelection | null` — Controlled selection (node or edge)
- `onSelectionChange: (selection: TopologySelection | null) => void` — Callback fired when selection changes
- `traceOnSelect: boolean` — Automatically trace and highlight upstream/downstream paths on selection
- `traceDirection: 'both' | 'upstream' | 'downstream'` — Direction of path tracing when an item is selected
- `searchQuery: string` — Optional search keyword dimming non-matching nodes
- `statusFilter: 'all' | Status` — Optional status filter ('all' | Status) dimming non-matching nodes
- `nodeStatusOverrides: Map<string, Status>` — External status overrides for nodes (e.g. fault impact simulation)
- `edgeStatusOverrides: Map<string, Status>` — External status overrides for edges
- `showGrid: boolean` — Show subtle Glaze dot grid background
- `surface: 'canvas' | 'transparent'` — Canvas surface mode ('canvas' uses #F2F4F8, 'transparent' blends inside a Tile)
- `draggable: boolean` — Allow dragging nodes to adjust layout temporarily
- `autoLayout: boolean` — Automatically compute collision-free compound layout with Eclipse Layout Kernel (`elkjs`)
- `layoutOptions: Omit<TopologyLayoutOptions, 'direction' | 'density'>` — Fine-grained ELK layout spacing & algorithm options when `autoLayout` is enabled
- `fitViewKey: string | number` — Automatically re-fit viewport when `fitViewKey` changes
- `className: string` — Container className (must supply explicit height or flex-1)
- `children: React.ReactNode` — Floating overlay children (`TopologyToolbar`, `TopologyLegend`, `TopologyMinimap`, etc.)

**Data Attributes:** `data-surface` (画布底面模式（canvas | transparent）), `data-direction` (当前布局方向（LR | TB）)

## TopologyNode (网络与架构节点) — `@glaze/topology-node`

通用云服务与网络设备节点，内置 18 种架构/设备图标、实时状态呼吸点、遥测指标栏、色调与紧凑/详细双密度模式。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/topology-node`
- Import: `import { TopologyKindIcon, TopologyNodeCard, TopologyNode } from '@/components/ui/topology-node'`
- Registry Deps: @glaze/hue-tag, @glaze/icon-tile, @glaze/status-dot, @glaze/status-pill, @glaze/style, @glaze/tokens, @glaze/topology

**TopologyKindIcon Props:**
- `kind: TopologyNodeKind` = 'service'
- `size: number` = 18

**TopologyNodeCard Props:**
- `data: TopologyNodeData` (required) — Node data payload
- `selected: boolean` = false — Whether the node is actively selected
- `dimmed: boolean` = false — Dim non-matching nodes when a path trace or search filter is active
- `effectiveStatus: Status` — Override visual status (e.g. cascaded fault status)
- `density: 'compact' | 'detailed'` — Density override ('compact' | 'detailed')

**Data Attributes:** `data-kind` (节点语义类型（service | database | firewall | switch 等 18 种）), `data-status` (当前健康状态（normal | warning | error | info | disabled）), `data-selected` (节点处于选中高亮态), `data-dimmed` (链路追踪或过滤时弱化显示)

## TopologyGroup (逻辑与物理分组容器) — `@glaze/topology-group`

用于表达 VPC、可用区 AZ、子网、K8s 集群、VLAN 与机柜边界的柔彩浅底分组容器，自带区域健康汇总胶囊。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/topology-group`
- Import: `import { TopologyGroupSurface, TopologyGroup } from '@/components/ui/topology-group'`
- Registry Deps: @glaze/hue-tag, @glaze/status-dot, @glaze/style, @glaze/tokens, @glaze/topology

**TopologyGroupSurface Props:**
- `data: TopologyGroupData` (required) — Group container metadata
- `selected: boolean` = false — Whether the group container is currently selected
- `dimmed: boolean` = false — Dim when outside an active trace
- `effectiveStatus: Status` — Status override (e.g. from cascading fault impact)

**Data Attributes:** `data-kind` (分组类型（vpc | az | subnet | cluster | vlan | rack | zone）), `data-status` (区域汇总状态), `data-selected` (分组被选中高亮)

## TopologyEdge (流量动效拓扑连线) — `@glaze/topology-edge`

支持正交折线与贝塞尔曲线的观测连线，内置状态着色、CSS 实时流量脉冲动画、冗余备线虚线及可点击的中点指标胶囊。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/topology-edge`
- Import: `import { TopologyEdge } from '@/components/ui/topology-edge'`
- Registry Deps: @glaze/style, @glaze/tokens, @glaze/topology

**Data Attributes:** `data-status` (链路健康状态（normal | warning | error | disabled）), `data-selected` (链路被选中高亮)

## TopologyControls (拓扑工具栏、图例与缩略图) — `@glaze/topology-controls`

包含全圆胶囊悬浮工具栏 TopologyToolbar（搜索、状态过滤、横纵切换、流量动效、缩放居中）、状态图例 TopologyLegend 与 Glaze 配色缩略图 TopologyMinimap。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/topology-controls`
- Import: `import { TopologyToolbar, TopologyLegend, TopologyMinimap } from '@/components/ui/topology-controls'`
- Registry Deps: @glaze/button, @glaze/status-dot, @glaze/tokens, @glaze/tooltip, @glaze/topology

**TopologyToolbar Props:**
- `position: PanelPosition` = 'bottom-center' — Position on the topology canvas
- `searchQuery: string` = '' — Search query value (enables inline pill search when `onSearchChange` is provided)
- `onSearchChange: (value: string) => void` — Search query change handler
- `statusFilter: 'all' | Status` = 'all' — Active status filter ('all' | 'normal' | 'warning' | 'error')
- `onStatusFilterChange: (status: 'all' | Status) => void` — Status filter change handler
- `onDirectionChange: (direction: TopologyDirection) => void` — Layout direction toggle handler ('LR' <-> 'TB')
- `onAnimateFlowChange: (animated: boolean) => void` — Traffic flow animation toggle handler
- `showZoomControls: boolean` = true — Show zoom in / zoom out / fitView controls
- `compact: boolean` = false — Compact mode hides button text labels to fit narrow embedded canvases
- `actions: React.ReactNode` — Extra action buttons rendered at the trailing end
- `className: string`

**TopologyLegend Props:**
- `position: PanelPosition` = 'bottom-left' — Position on the canvas
- `items: TopologyLegendItem[]` = DEFAULT_LEGEND_ITEMS — Custom legend items; defaults to Glaze semantic health states
- `className: string`

**TopologyMinimap Props:**
- `position: PanelPosition` = 'bottom-right' — Position on the canvas
- `width: number` = 168 — Minimap width in px
- `height: number` = 108 — Minimap height in px
- `className: string`

## TopologyInspector (节点与链路详情检查器) — `@glaze/topology-inspector`

右侧悬浮观测检查器，统一支持节点、分组与链路详情查看，集成实时指标卡、SparkChart 趋势、上下游跳转列表、最近告警事件与故障注入演练按钮。
- Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @glaze/topology-inspector`
- Import: `import { TopologyInspector } from '@/components/ui/topology-inspector'`
- Registry Deps: @glaze/button, @glaze/hue-tag, @glaze/icon-tile, @glaze/scroll-area, @glaze/spark-chart, @glaze/status-dot, @glaze/status-pill, @glaze/style, @glaze/tokens, @glaze/topology, @glaze/topology-node

**TopologyInspector Props:**
- `nodes: TopologyFlowNode[]` (required) — All nodes in the current topology graph
- `edges: TopologyFlowEdge[]` (required) — All edges in the current topology graph
- `selection: TopologySelection | null` (required) — Currently selected node or edge
- `onClose: () => void` — Close inspector callback
- `onSelect: (selection: TopologySelection) => void` — Jump to another node or edge from upstream/downstream hops
- `nodeStatusOverrides: Map<string, Status>` — Optional status overrides (e.g. fault simulation)
- `edgeStatusOverrides: Map<string, Status>` — Optional edge status overrides
- `isFaultInjected: boolean` = false — Whether the selected node is currently injected as a simulated fault
- `onToggleFault: (nodeId: string) => void` — Optional handler to toggle fault simulation on the selected node
- `footerActions: React.ReactNode` — Custom footer actions
- `className: string`

**Data Attributes:** `data-kind` (当前检查对象类型（edge | group | 节点类型）), `data-status` (当前对象健康状态)
